title: ירושלים, יער רמות (Jerusalem, Ramot Forest)
author: Y. Rapuano, E. Shabo
location_note: North-west slope of the Shu'fat ridge.
notes: About 30 stone cairns built at the end of Iron II (some perhaps cultic); scattered Persian, Late Hellenistic and Early Roman sherds around them.
extra_quotes: מלמד שגלי האבנים נבנו בשלהי תקופת הברזל הב׳

features.subtype: rock-cut installation (no. 3): basin fed by two channels, covered by a cairn
features.period: covered by the late Iron II cairns
features.quote: היה ,חצוב והוא כולל אגן שאליו מתנקזות שתי .תעלות

title: ירושלים, גבעת המבתר (Jerusalem, Giv'at Ha-Mivtar)
author: G. Solimany, B. Zissu
location_note: Nablus Rd., north of the Ha-Mateh Ha-Arzi junction.
extra_quotes: המאה הב׳ לפסה״נ עד המאה הא׳ .לסה״נ

features.subtype: burial cave: chamber with standing pit, kokhim, covered trough grave, repository; ossuaries (one with rosettes); 22 individuals; coins of Alexander Jannaeus and Pontius Pilate
features.period: end of the 2nd c. BCE to the 1st c. CE
features.quote: על פי הממצא הקיראמי והנומיסמטי נראה שהמערה היתה בשימוש משלהי

title: ירושלים, מעיין הגיחון (Jerusalem, Ha-Gihon Spring)
author: R. Reich, E. Shukron
location_note: Gihon spring, City of David; no map reference in this report (HA 107: 172500/131175). Screen miss: the heading is a Jerusalem item whose group heading was not captured.
notes: Massive Middle Bronze II tower partly rock-cut protecting the spring and pool; Warren's shaft system in two phases (MB II and Iron II).
extra_quotes: ובחלקו העליון — רובד של עפר תחוח מעורב בחרסים מימי הבית .השני

features.subtype: rock-cut pool (Parker's 'round chamber') fed by channels II and III, enclosed by rock-cut and megalithic walls
features.period: with the Middle Bronze II fortification
features.quote: נחשפו שוליה העליונים של בריכה חצובה

features.subtype: natural cave above Warren's shaft with complete Early Bronze I vessels; later Iron II quarrying debris
Warren's shaft system: horizontal and sloping tunnels cut in two phases
features.period: phase A Middle Bronze II; phase B Iron II

features.subtype: channel II, rock-cut 4-5 m deep and covered with large stones, cleared for 40 m; lower fill Iron II, upper fill with Second Temple sherds
features.period: construction not dated here (covering stones like the MB II fortifications); silted in the Iron II and Second Temple periods
features.quote: נוקה חלקה הצפוני של תעלה II

features.subtype: channel III, narrow tunnel branching west toward the Area C pool
features.period: with the Middle Bronze II pool system

title: ירושלים, חומת העיר העתיקה (Jerusalem, The Old-City Wall)
author: J. Seligman
location_note: Armenian Patriarchate St., inner side of the south Old City wall. Screen miss: Jerusalem item whose group heading was not captured.
notes: Medieval tower and wall (perhaps Ayyubid, al-Mu'azzam 'Isa) under the Ottoman wall.

features.subtype: rock-cut installation (1.5 x 2.0 m) with three L-shaped steps, dark grey plaster with ash; excavator: cistern or miqveh
features.quote: נראה כי המיתקן שימש כבור מים או כמקווה .טהרה

title: ירושלים, מר אליאס - כנסיית הקתיסמה (Jerusalem, Mar Elias - the Kathisma Church)
author: R. Avner
location_note: Eastern part of the octagonal church near the Mar Elias monastery (HA 100: 17020-30/12690-700).
notes: Octagonal Byzantine church, mosaics; rock-cut steps (L104) of an access in phase II.

features.subtype: plastered channels built into the cores of the church walls

title: יער ביתר (Betar Forest)
author: Y. Barukh, A. Sharukh
notes: Four field towers among ancient terraces, Iron II to Hellenistic; iron ploughshare. No feature of the eligible classes.
extra_quotes: המגדלים היו □פזורי על פני שטח של כארבעה

title: ג׳בל אל־חאבון (אלון שבות) (Jebel el-Habun, Allon Shevut)
author: D. Amit
location_note: Ridge on the watershed north-east of Allon Shevut, near the miqveh reported in HA 101-102.
notes: Single-period Iron I courtyard enclosure (11th c. BCE); tower or fort with Roman-Byzantine sherds perhaps originally Iron I.

features.subtype: two conical cupmarks joined by a groove, a domestic press installation
bell-shaped rock-cut cistern with round opening (c. 3 m), 50 m south-west of the building
features.quote: נחשף בור מים חצוב בעל פתח עגול

features.subtype: second cistern 30 m further south, in use today, perhaps ancient

title: חורבת קומרן - חרותת (H. Qumran - Graffito)
author: B. Safrai
location_note: Aqueduct c. 50 m west of Kh. Qumran (built-site aqueduct, not a cave report; read under phase-2 plan section 7).
notes: Ship graffito on a dolomite fieldstone in the west side of the aqueduct (1.2 m wide).

features.subtype: aqueduct of Kh. Qumran (stone bearing the graffito in its west side)
features.quote: על אחת מאבניה של אמת המים

title: ירושלים, קשת רובינסון (Jerusalem, Robinson's Arch)
author: R. Reich, Y. Billig
location_note: Herodian street along the Western Wall; no map reference.
notes: About 15 coins sealed under the street paving, the latest of Pontius Pilate: paving decades after Herod, probably under Agrippa II. No feature of the eligible classes.

title: ירושלים, רחוב דיסקין (Jerusalem, Diskin St.)
author: R. Abu Riya, G. Solimany
extra_quotes: על שתיים מהגלוסקמות שנתגלו בחדר זה

features.subtype: burial cave: chamber with standing pit and plastered bench, four kokhim, side room with seven ossuaries and a kokh; two ossuaries inscribed with a name in Hebrew and Greek
features.period: not stated in the report (ossuary burial)
